as_told.title: Rocket over the Triangle swerves as a UFO appears

plain: During one of many rocket launches on Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, an unidentified object appeared in the sky, and minutes later a Blackhawk military helicopter came over the mesa and hovered above the property. Brandon Fugal, who says he was there, tells Michels this happened above a patch of the ranch called the triangle. In his account, the object, which he calls a UAP, short for unidentified aerial phenomenon, showed up while the team was launching. Then, "within minutes," the helicopter "descends over the property, and just hovers right over the south field." Michels tells a version of his own from a 2022 episode about searching for UFOs on the ranch. He puts the weight on the rocket rather than the helicopter. He says it "made an abrupt deflection to the west as if it were avoiding something," though there was no wind to push it that way, and he does not mention the Blackhawk. If both are right, something unseen bent a rocket's path over the ranch, and the military seemed to be watching closely enough to show up within minutes.
